verification.notes: The statement correctly presents allegations rather than guilt. Federal complaints and AP reporting identify Havsgaard as a former Harvest pastor/missionary and describe allegations of abuse at a Bucharest shelter, including tying children to radiators or beds, forcing them to kneel on walnut shells, inappropriate sexual conduct, and trafficking/pimping boys for sex.
